versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Climbing plants that never grow on their own: they hang on a host unit and copy every stat it gains.
Buff the host and all its Climbers rise with it, but if the host dies they fall with it.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Clearer wording where reviewers couldn't read a card: Cousin Dodder's enemy climb, Ruin Ivy, Viscum, and how the Grand Oak stacks with Viscum (it doubles only its own gains).
Small upgrades: Hazel Wand counts Climbers next to it, you pick who Blooms on Ivy in Flower, and Ruin Ivy redirects tribe bonuses too.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
